name: Owlbear
canary: CANARY — print-exact floor; no condition slot, must be untouched.

description: a kenku thief who speaks only in stolen voices
canary: CANARY — species kit, no fear mechanic anywhere; nothing should change.

description: a sellsword who hurls a handaxe and closes with a shortsword
canary: CANARY — weapon table, physical damage only. No fear to strip, and its weapon rows must stay intact.

description: a brass tyrant whose furnace breath terrifies and whose hammer finds the terrified
canary: FEATURE — the measured offender: Furnace Breath dealt 72 Fire AND frightened on 26 rows. The clause must leave, and the payoff rider that CONSUMES Frightened must then be stripped too unless something else frightens.

description: a mind flayer whose psychic scream unmakes the will
canary: FEATURE — Psychic is one of the two types print DOES pair with fear. The condition must SURVIVE here; this is the arm that proves the gate is not a blanket ban.

description: a bell-wraith whose thunderous toll deafens and terrifies
canary: FEATURE — Thunder is the other licensed type, and print pairs Thunder with Deafened 2 of 2. Both should be allowed.

description: a frost giant whose breath freezes the blood with terror
canary: FEATURE — Cold: print has 29 Cold rows and ZERO minor conditions. The concept ASKS for terror, so this tests whether stripping reads as a loss the GM would notice.

description: a gallows-spectre whose withering gaze breaks the will
canary: FEATURE — the gaze class: a no-damage fear row is print's MODAL form (7 of 11) and must be untouched. If it ships Bludgeoning damage instead, that is the damage type bug, not this gate.

description: a plague-herald whose necrotic wave fills the living with dread
canary: FEATURE — Necrotic was the owner's own guess and print does NOT support it (0 of 11). Judge whether the strip reads wrong here.

description: a dread knight whose charge shatters courage and bone
canary: FEATURE — physical damage plus fear, the clearest print violation (0 of 11). The fear should leave the damage row.
